scope: One single-scene baseline/candidate comparison with real WKWebView callbacks, long active lifetime, navigation, fold and delayed events. No scene API, logical peer, Replay content or physical claim.
source_findings: Browser receiver preserves browser view/source/service/sdk identity, replaces native application/session, and resolves container from corrected browser event time and Replay-eligible cache entries. Native mapper does not observe raw Browser writes.

Candidate active entries survive elapsed TTL; inactive entries expire more than 180 seconds after native deactivation. Baseline insertion of B purges insertion-aged A after its active lifetime exceeds 180 seconds.

Physical removal of a WKWebView is not the cache deactivation/expiry boundary. A delayed old-dated event before inactive expiry may correctly retain A after detach; after expiry it must not inherit B.

ordered_markers.precondition: Actual native A active and Replay-eligible; same WKWebView stays attached for more than 180 seconds in both wall and monotonic clocks. Freeze M3/M4 A-dated envelopes, then perform actual Open while A remains active.
ordered_markers.browser_event: Fresh A event; retain two additional immutable A-dated envelopes for M3/M4.
ordered_markers.expected: Exact A container in both arms; original Browser ID remains distinct.

ordered_markers.precondition: After the proved Open transition, perform actual A-to-B native navigation. B readiness mapper and fresh B document readiness precede emission. Do not wait for a backend acknowledgement or Closed gesture before M3.
ordered_markers.expected: Exact B container; same native process/scene/session; no accidental A assignment.

ordered_markers.precondition: Immediately after M2 actual callback, remove retained A WKWebView; prove window==nil and independently mapped B active. Emit M3 while the earliest deactivation bracket is less than 180 seconds old. Require M3 marker-specific backend acknowledgement within that same fixed bracket.
ordered_markers.browser_event: Emit the first frozen A-dated envelope through the same real retained WKWebView/installed SDK handler.
ordered_markers.expected: Candidate A container; baseline container absent after B insertion purges insertion-aged A. Never assign B.

ordered_markers.precondition: After M3 backend acknowledgement, perform actual Closed and wait until more than 180 seconds beyond the latest possible A deactivation in both wall and monotonic clocks. B remains active.
ordered_markers.browser_event: Emit second frozen A-dated envelope through the real callback; then disable tracking and release retained A.
ordered_markers.expected: Candidate container absent; Browser/application/session identity preserved; no B inheritance. Prove A deallocation with weak reference after callback/write completion.

capture_contract: Immutable per-arm run/nonce/source/helper/build/product identity, complete owned scene/window/controller/actual display inventory and current native A/B mapper IDs.

Record JavaScript invocation, actual WKScriptMessage receipt/body/WebView identity/attachment, native deactivation interval and marker-specific raw Datadog MCP acknowledgement separately. Normal SDK upload; no forwarding proxy.
An exact event acknowledgement is repeatable and tied to its browser UUID. currentSessionID, page load completion and elapsed sleep are not writer barriers.
Query full application/session without native service or SDK filters; independent count and complete raw pages, then exact native/browser partitions. Keep raw available view revisions.
After required evidence, stop task SDK work, remove only the task app, prove original display/device/app inventory and input-worker quiescence. Separate scenario/evidence/cleanup verdicts.

Bracket deactivation with the native B transition entry and independently mapped ready receipt; verify wall and monotonic TTL intervals separately. Never compare a Date-derived TTL to an uncalibrated DispatchTime duration.

Use actual native mapper view-start dates and raw MCP client_time for corrected event-date ownership; wall/monotonic receipt clocks qualify elapsed TTL separately. Preserve exact raw row and source/service envelope; never fill missing backend fields from callback evidence.

Serialize immutable scalar snapshots off callback paths in enqueue order. Require durable_sequence equal to the complete record count and await the evidence writer flush; persistence failure remains sticky.

timing_decision: Keep both UI round trips outside the short inactive-retention boundary: Open before B, Closed after M3 backend acknowledgement. Do not pause between B and M3 for model/UI interaction. Any missed inactive deadline invalidates the cell; no retry/extension.

marker_oracle.scope: Offline marker/ownership/backend-projection controls; Swift syntax; Foundation concurrent ordered persistence, durable flush and sticky failure. No native or backend acceptance.
